claims.explanation: Zardaverine is a dual PDE3/4 inhibitor that raises cAMP and activates PKA, so selective killing likely occurs in cancers that express the target phosphodiesterases and depend on cAMP-sensitive survival signaling. The observed sensitive lines are enriched for BRAF- or KRAS-mutant MAPK-driven lineages, whereas NRAS-mutant lines tend to be spared. PDE4D/PDE3A expression and an intact cAMP-PKA-CREB axis are therefore the most plausible predictors of sensitivity.
